usage: ndkgdb [options]

options:
  -v, --verbose          enable verbose mode
  -f, --force            kill existing debug session if it exists
  --port PORT            override the port used on the host (default: 5039)
  --delay DELAY          delay in seconds to wait after starting activity
                         (default: 0.25, higher values may be needed on
                         slower devices)
  -p, --project PROJECT  specify application project path
  --lldb                 use lldb
  --no-lldb              do not use lldb

target selection:
  --attach [PKG_NAME]    attach to application (default)
                         autodetects PKG_NAME if not specified
  --launch [ACTIVITY]    launch application activity
                         launches main activity if ACTIVITY not specified
  --launch-list          list all launchable activity names from manifest

device selection:
  -a                     directs commands to all interfaces
  -d                     directs commands to the only connected USB device
  -e                     directs commands to the only connected emulator
  -s SERIAL              directs commands to device/emulator with the given
                         serial

debugging options:
  -x, --exec EXEC_FILE   execute gdb commands in EXEC_FILE after connection
  --nowait               do not wait for debugger to attach (may miss early
                         JNI breakpoints)
  -t, --tui              use GDB's tui mode

other:
  --adb ADB              use specific adb command
  --version              show version information and exit
  -h, --help             show this help message and exit
